lines.text: Every Heart a Doorway is the first book in the Wayward Children Series. It's filled with magical doorways into unusual worlds. Each book adds a new dimension and takes you on a journey that surprises you. This series is perfect for misfits and queer folk. Samantha's Reviews Staff Pick May 2026
